title: What If You Stood on Ganymede, the Moon Bigger Than Mercury?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Ganymede? This moon is bigger than Mercury, and makes its own magnetic field.
It's about 5,270 kilometers wide, larger than Mercury. Yet it has only about half of Mercury's mass.
Gravity is about one seventh of Earth's, so a 70 kilogram person would weigh about 10 kilograms.
The surface averages around minus 160 degrees Celsius, far colder than any place on Earth.
Its magnetic field sits entirely inside Jupiter's, a magnetic bubble within a bubble.
Deep below your boots, scientists think there's a salty ocean, buried under ice. It is no ordinary moon.

description:
What if you stood on Jupiter's moon Ganymede?
It's bigger than Mercury, it's the only moon with its own magnetic field, and scientists think a salty ocean hides under its ice.
